title: Transportation & Parking – Bank of America Chicago Marathon
claims: The page recommends Chicago's CTA rail system for spectators moving along the course.

CTA stations listed near the course include Grand (miles 1, 3 and 12.5), Jackson (mile 2), Chicago (miles 3.5 and 12.25), Clark/Division (miles 4 and 12), Sheridan (mile 8), Addison (mile 8.5), Sedgwick (mile 11), Washington/Wells (mile 13.5), UIC-Halsted (miles 14 and 17), 18th (mile 19.25), Cermak-Chinatown (mile 21.5), Sox-35th (miles 23, 23.25 and 23.5), 35th-Bronzeville-IIT (miles 23, 23.25 and 23.5), Cermak-McCormick Place (mile 25) and Roosevelt (finish line).
Spectators are encouraged to move along the course throughout the event.
The page does not describe a runner drop-out procedure or state that runners may leave the course at CTA stations.
